rationale.reason: Complete fruit presses/crushers for beverage manufacture fit 8435.10; fruit and beverage output itself is not the reference product.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This candidate PCR covers factory manufacture of new complete machines that mechanically press fruit mash or crush/mill fruit for wine, cider or fruit-juice preparation. Define one finished machine and one configuration per dataset, including installed support, working chamber, pressing or crushing mechanism, supplied guards and control, and declared delivered accessories. Speidel documents a water-pressure natural-rubber diaphragm press with stainless basket; Voran documents a historical electric centrifugal fruit mill with exchangeable stainless screens. These are different design routes, not a combined mandatory component list. Exclude beverage manufacture, fruit cultivation/harvesting, juice yield, later operation water/electricity, cleaning-in-use, maintenance, lifetime and end of life. Also exclude standalone washers/elevators, pasteurisers, fermenters, bottling/packaging machinery, oilseed presses, grain mills, mining crushers, separately sold parts and remanufacture. Installed preparation subassemblies belong only where explicitly included in the single machine BOM; separately delivered equipment is separately modelled. Scientific methodology review is pending.
reviewed_boundary.covered: New complete configured fruit presses and fruit crushers/mills
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Beverages, cultivation, standalone washing/lifting/thermal/filling equipment, non-fruit crushers and separately sold parts
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Accepted complete machine at declared factory gate, loose spares and packaging excluded from net machine mass

English and Chinese searches do not establish the declared welded circular AISI304 stock identity.
Searches return unrelated steel wire, generic welding service or incompatible consumables; no verified 308L solid-wire identity.
English and Chinese queries did not establish a compatible pure argon shielding-gas identity.
No compatible collected stainless grinding-dust Waste identity; elementary airborne particulate cannot substitute.
Search establishes no compatible finished aluminium-oxide abrasive disc; raw alumina candidates do not represent the product.
363302a6 direct reference is Aluminium content, not Mass; cannot use its kg aluminium quantity as kg waste paint.
Search does not establish the declared untreated alkaline bath as a Waste flow for external treatment; tap water or elementary discharge is not compatible.
No compatible untreated nitric-acid passivation bath Waste identity; industrial treatment or elementary water-release candidates have different boundaries.
No compatible finished fruit-press basket identity; stainless stock and mill screens are different products.
No compatible finished natural-rubber hydropress diaphragm; raw rubber and polypropylene diaphragm candidates are incompatible.
No verified complete water-pressure relief valve with gauge; generic valves lack the specified assembly/medium boundary.
No compatible finished polyester fruit-press filter bag; generic fabric is not the made-up product.
No compatible finished perforated fruit-mill screen identity; flat stainless stock or unrelated screening machinery cannot substitute.
Search does not establish the specified finished fruit-mill cutting rotor; unrelated rotor or metal stock is incompatible.
014f80a3 direct comment restricts the purchased motor to conveyor/washing modules with expert estimates; not a verified fruit-mill motor identity.
No compatible single start-stop switch assembly; pooled electrical/control parts are not atomic substitutes.
Search does not verify the specified finished stainless hexagonal bolt; mixed fasteners are not compatible.
No compatible declared food-contact finished EPDM gasket; generic rubber is not the finished seal.
No compatible external-treatment Waste flow for the actual spent factory water-test liquid; tap water and elementary freshwater do not match.

evidence_needs: Design sources do not supply primary manufacturing quantities, M, recipe, measured allocation drivers or factory emission observations. Obtain configured foreground records without inventing generic mass, lifetime, concentration, operating demand or range.
Reconcile actual BOM/route and upstream, incoming transport and waste-treatment coverage before claiming a complete cradle-to-gate dataset. Voran3/18 is historical design evidence only.
